decisions.reason: Because Product A builds closely on the firm's existing compliance and hosting knowledge and the firm conducts R&D, management can interpret early feedback and improve it, so dropping is unlikely.
As a flagship web hosting management platform that builds on the firm's established offer and benefits from internal R&D, it is central to the firm's direction and highly likely to be kept.
Product C is a configurable managed hosting plan close to the firm's existing knowledge, so with internal R&D the firm can assimilate market results and continue improving it, making a drop unlikely.
